data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'misah' meaning moon. In some cultures, the moon goddess is revered for her nurturing, maternal, and protective qualities. The name Miesha carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Miesha usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
